candidate.reason: Same issuer, same basis (reported), same currency (USD), same fiscal horizon (FY2025), same metric (total revenue). The FY2025 revenue guidance range was revised upward from approximately $2.60–$2.62 billion (Sept 3, 2024) to approximately $2.623–$2.643 billion (Dec 2, 2024). Per the rules, a numerical revision or direction change alone is not itself a conflict; this is recorded only as a guidance update for human review.
